descriptionChirho: Proper noun designating Ophir, the renowned source of fine gold, mentioned in contexts of Solomon's maritime trade and wealth. English 'Ophir / from–Ophir / Ofirah,' Spanish 'Ofir / desde–Ofir / a–Ofir,' Hindi 'ओपीर / ओपीर–से,' Arabic 'أُوفِيرَ / مِنْ–أُوفِيرَ / أُوفيرَ,' Korean '오빌 / –에서–오빌 / 오보르로,' Swahili 'Ofiri / kutoka–Ofiri.' The variant 'Ofirah' (S80568, 1x) is an alternate form of the same geographic name; all occurrences refer to the same legendary gold-producing region.
